verdict.rationale: Aider automatically builds a concise map of the whole git repository, showing key classes, functions and call signatures. You can print it with /map, ask questions without editing via /ask, and use aider without adding any files while it works out which files are relevant. A community user independently reports that aider did a fantastic job explaining unfamiliar codebases, and another says it answers questions that LSP search can't. Missing for 10: docs on how the repo map scales to very large repos, and evidence that full file contents (not just signatures) are pulled in for deep explanations without manual /add.
